hook: Jet engines on your arms can really make you fly.
title: A Man Really Flies With Jet Engines
description:
Richard Browning of Gravity Industries flies using jet engines on his arms and back, and the footage shows him in the air. He steers by moving his arms. Series: Facts That Sound Fake.

#Shorts #JetSuit #Technology
